text_block_list.name: Narrator
text_block_list.text: One day, during a break in team training.

text_block_list.name: Taiki Shuttle
text_block_list.text: Trainer! Howdy! I have a favor to ask!

text_block_list.name: Taiki Shuttle
text_block_list.text: I love this team very, very much!

text_block_list.name: Taiki Shuttle
text_block_list.text:
So I want to take a picture with the team 
and show it to my family, YES!

text_block_list.name: Taiki Shuttle
text_block_list.text:
If my family sees pictures of everyone, 
they'll definitely be so, so happy!

text_block_list.name: Taiki Shuttle
text_block_list.text:
No! I want Trainer-san to be in the photo 
too!

text_block_list.name: Taiki Shuttle
text_block_list.text:
If we use the self-timer, we can take a 
picture with the whole team together!

text_block_list.name: Taiki Shuttle
text_block_list.text:
Of course! Without you, Trainer-san, it 
just wouldn't be a complete picture of our 
team!

text_block_list.name: Narrator
text_block_list.text: And so, the photoshoot began—

text_block_list.name: Taiki Shuttle
text_block_list.text:
Mmm, standing on top of the keeper feels a 
little un-steady...

text_block_list.name: Taiki Shuttle
text_block_list.text:
Phone-san, just hang in there for 10 
seconds!

text_block_list.name: Taiki Shuttle
text_block_list.text:
OK! Gather round, everyooonne! With a 
happy smile! Let's goooo!

text_block_list.name: Taiki Shuttle
text_block_list.text: Three, two...!

text_block_list.name: Narrator
text_block_list.text: (WHOOSH!)

text_block_list.name: Taiki Shuttle
text_block_list.text: Oh my god! Smartphone-san, fall ouuut!!

text_block_list.name: Narrator
text_block_list.text: (—*click!*)

text_block_list.name: Taiki Shuttle
text_block_list.text:
No... I'm sure only the sky is in the 
photo――

text_block_list.name: Taiki Shuttle
text_block_list.text: —Oh! Ahaha!

text_block_list.name: Taiki Shuttle
text_block_list.text:
Look at this! I took a suuuper great 
picture♪

text_block_list.name: Narrator
text_block_list.text:
What turned out was a very happy photo of 
Taiki Shuttle rushing over in a flurry, 
and the team members laughing!

We were able to make wonderful memories 
together.
